entries.wording: 目的地：…，…件，货物由…开单入库
entries.note: The waybill opened at the branch the row names, with its destination city and piece count; the reader drops the consignee the page names between them.
The line truck left for the hub the row names. The firm writes 己 for 已.
Arrived at the hub the row names and being unloaded.

entries.wording: 己和收货人联系好今天派送
entries.note: The destination branch arranged the delivery with the consignee for the day; the round itself is the next row.

entries.wording: 己和收货人核实下午己签收
entries.note: The branch confirmed with the consignee that the freight was signed for that afternoon.
